title: Frequently asked questions
description: Answers about prerequisites, progress, computation, and course status.
page_type: resource
---

## Is completion a grade or certificate?

No. Progress is a local study bookmark. The project does not issue grades,
credentials, or readiness guarantees.

## Where is progress stored?

Only in your browser's local storage. You can export, import, and reset it. No
name, answer history, or analytics record is sent to FreeCampus Math.

## Should I use SymPy before solving manually?

Usually no. Predict a result and show the mathematical method first; then use
SymPy to verify, explore edge cases, or extend the problem.

## What does “in development” mean?

The published structure is usable, but an item bank, assessment, or course is
still being expanded or audited against all declared outcomes.
